fields.label: Node ID
fields.description: Identifies the node within its workflow; edges reference it and a parked Instance stores it as its cursor, so it must be stable and unique.

fields.label: Node Type
fields.description: Selects the node's behaviour - Step, Branch, Assign, Wait, or Terminal; the fields below are shown per type.

fields.label: Action Group
fields.description: Names the reusable Action Group a Step node runs.

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Holds the expression a Branch node evaluates against Instance state; a true result follows On True, otherwise On False.

fields.label: Assign (Expression)
fields.description: Holds the expression an Assign node evaluates to a dict that updates Instance state (e.g. increment a counter) with no external effect.

fields.label: Wait Mode
fields.options:
For Duration
Until Time
Until Event
Event-or-Timeout
fields.description: Selects how a Wait node resumes - after a duration, at a time, on an event, or on an event-or-timeout.

fields.label: Wait Expression
fields.description: Holds the delay (For Duration - e.g. {"minutes": 5}) or the deadline expression (Until Time, or the timeout of Event-or-Timeout).

fields.label: Signal Name
fields.description: Names the external event a Wait node waits for; a delivered signal of this name resumes the Instance.

fields.label: Accepts (JSON)
fields.description: Maps declared payload paths of an incoming signal to Instance-state keys; only these paths merge, bounding an arbitrary payload to a known shape.

fields.label: Next Node
fields.description: Points to the node followed when this Step, Assign, or pure-timer Wait completes.

fields.label: On True
fields.description: Points to the node followed when a Branch node's condition is true.

fields.label: On False
fields.description: Points to the node followed when a Branch node's condition is false.

fields.label: On Event
fields.description: Points to the node followed when a Wait node's awaited signal arrives.

fields.label: On Timeout
fields.description: Points to the node followed when a Wait node's timeout elapses before its signal arrives.
